correctness.rationale: For n>=2 and 1<=r<=n, the diagonal-conjugation C-star action with weights 2^i makes all ordered nonzero differences distinct. The ambient projective fixed locus comprises a diagonal P^{n-1} and n(n-1) isolated off-diagonal matrix-unit points, all nilpotent and in every r>=1 level. Diagonal classes with exactly b eigenvalues are indexed by set partitions into b blocks and quotient of ordered Conf_b(C) by common C* scaling. For b>=2 normalize the first two entries to difference one; the quotient is C×Conf_{b-2}(C\{0,1}) with χ_c=(-1)^(b-2)(b-2)!, while b=1 contributes 1. Torus localization and additivity give χ_closed=n(n-1)+sum_{b<=r} S(n,b)q_b, exact first layer n(n-1)+1, and higher S(n,r)q_r. Independently enumerate all set partitions through n=8 and verify χ(X_{n,n})=n^2, also n=2,3 boundaries; general proof uses configuration fibration, not finite checks.

Vassiliev’s related Hermitian spectral strata lie in a real operator space and do not imply this complex projective matrix Euler filtration. Previously published SCOPE projectivized eigenvalue-coincidence filtration counts spectra shared with the northwest corner, an inequivalent condition.
